title: Interpolation parameters for the low-norms case
statement:
Let $p, u, \rho$ be real numbers with $1 < p < u < 2$, and suppose $\rho^2 = (p-1)/(u-1)$. Then there exist real numbers $\theta \in (0,1)$ and $s > 0$ such that
\[
  \frac{1}{p} = \frac{\theta}{1+\rho^2} + \frac{1-\theta}{s}
  \qquad\text{and}\qquad
  \frac{1}{u} = \frac{\theta}{2} + \frac{1-\theta}{s}.
\]
replaced:
Let $1 < p < u < 2$ and $\rho^2 = (p-1)/(u-1)$. Then there exist $\theta \in (0,1)$ and
$s > 0$ with
\[
  \frac1p = \frac{\theta}{1+\rho^2} + \frac{1-\theta}{s}
  \qquad\text{and}\qquad
  \frac1u = \frac{\theta}{2} + \frac{1-\theta}{s}.
\]
